description: Erection of a single storey side infill and part rear extension, and the conversion of the garage to habitable space.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (10W38LL-1; 10W38LL-2; 10W38LL-3; 10W38LL-4; 10W38LL-5; 10W38LL-6; 10W38LL-7; 10W38LL-8; 10W38LL-9
Received:  25 November 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors and other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey side infill and rear extensions hereby approved.
